name: Andrographis Paniculata
summary: Andrographis Paniculata (Andrographis paniculata) carries a Grade C rating — limited evidence. Strongest recorded design is a randomized controlled trial, drawn from 2 recorded studies, 1 in people. Recorded activity centres on inflammatory signaling modulation, immune signaling modulation and NF-kB modulation, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include pregnancy/breastfeeding without clinician supervision and known allergy to the plant/family.
description: Andrographis Paniculata botanical profile with evidence, safety, and practical fit.
safetyNotes: SAFETY ALERT: Andrographis-containing medicines have been associated with unpredictable severe allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis. Australia's TGA received 287 reports through 31 December 2025, including one fatal case in 2024. On 17 September 2026, Australia excluded Andrographis from NEW lower-risk listed medicines; this did not automatically ban existing products or establish a worldwide ban. Emergency symptoms such as throat swelling, breathing difficulty or collapse require immediate medical attention. Also avoid during pregnancy and seek medication-interaction advice, especially with immunosuppressants.
contraindications: Severe allergy or prior suspected reaction to Andrographis
Pregnancy: avoid without qualified medical guidance
interactions: use clinician review for high-dose extracts or chronic use.
Potential interaction with immunosuppressive medicines; seek clinical advice before use
